title: Retreat-to-Routine Carryover Rate
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:retreat retreat_name=* routine_kept=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(routine_kept="yes",1,0))) as matched by retreat_name
| eval a_habit_carried_home_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_habit_carried_home_pct
description: Measures the percentage of post-retreat routines that end with a habit carried home by retreat.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which retreat are helping or hurting post-retreat routines.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a habit carried home` on `faith:retreat` events and summarize the hit rate by `retreat_name`.
visualization: Table of retreat with percentage of post-retreat routines ending with a habit carried home.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often a habit carried home happens for each retreat so you can see where post-retreat routines go smoothly or get stuck.
